Maya (PM): Quick nudge on PMR-2026-58 overdue actions. Tracker shows 3 items still open and this PM is hitting a recurring pattern. Can owners confirm status/firm ETA by EOD Wed or I'll escalate to Eng leads. @Zoe @Marcus @Eve

Zoe (SRE): Ack. I'm owner of AI-41 (kv-cache tombstone cleanup) but got pulled onto an incident yesterday. I'll carve out time today and open a draft PR by EOD. Tentative ETA: 2026-04-20.

Marcus (Oncall): AI-42 (ingress rate-limit tuning) I haven't started. Bandwidth low this sprint. If this is critical, reassign to Eve or squad rotation.

Eve (Eng Infra): I can pick that up if Marcus wants to reassign. Also AI-43 (recurring-incident detector) I have an initial query for trend detection but need schema access to run it at scale.

Maya (PM): Adding the items inline for visibility:

```
PMR-2026-58 actions:
AI-41: kv-cache tombstone cleanup + runbook owner: Zoe status: not started (incident pull) ETA: ?
AI-42: ingress rate-limit tuning + canary owner: Marcus status: not started ETA: ?
AI-43: recurring-incident detector (trend job) owner: Eve status: partial prototype ETA: ?
```

Maya (PM): Please drop ETAs inline. If owners need reassign, say so now. This PM is part of a larger trend we want to break.

sre-bot: Reminder: 3 overdue actions for PMR-2026-58. Next escalation in 48h. :warning:

Zoe (SRE): Update: spun up branch with test vectors, PR incoming: https://git.redwood/PR/8234. ETA merge: 2026-04-20 EOD. I'll add runbook steps in the PR description.

Marcus (Oncall): Reassign AI-42 to @Eve please, I can't cover it this sprint. If Eve accepts, ETA would be 2026-04-19 for config + short canary.

Eve (Eng Infra): Taking AI-42. Dropping config snippet here for review:

```yaml
rate_limit:
  window_ms: 1000
  max_requests: 1200
```

Eve (Eng Infra): Also updated the trend query prototype and ran a small sample against staging logs. Findings: increased retry storms correlate with a particular client version. Will need a daily job to surface the pattern. ETA for AI-43: 2026-04-22.

Maya (PM): Thanks. Updated ETAs: AI-41 -> 2026-04-20, AI-42 -> 2026-04-19 (owner: Eve), AI-43 -> 2026-04-22. Please post a one-line verification here after your canary / job runs so I can close the PMR.

Zoe (SRE): PR merged: https://git.redwood/PR/8234 runbook attached. Will monitor tombstone count for 24h and report.

Eve (Eng Infra): Config applied to staging and canary scheduled 2026-04-19 11:00-11:15 UTC. I'll post verification after window (service: ingress, metric: 5xx rate, time).

Marcus (Oncall): Thx all. Reassign worked for me.

sre-bot: Tracker updated: AI-41 -> merged; AI-42 -> canary scheduled; AI-43 -> prototype scheduled. Auto-close when verification comments added. :white_check_mark:

Eve (Eng Infra): Canary passed. Verification: ingress canary 2026-04-19 11:00-11:15 UTC, 5xx rate unchanged, p95 latency within threshold. Added verification tag to PMR-2026-58.

Zoe (SRE): Verification: tombstone count reduced 48% over 24h, no regression observed. Added verification note to PMR.

Maya (PM): Excellent thank you. I'll finalize the postmortem and remove the watchlist. If the recurring detector surfaces new clusters next week, we'll reopen. :tada:
